name: Galleria at Tyler
description: Galleria at Tyler is a premier enclosed regional shopping mall serving the Inland Empire region of Southern California. Featuring major department store anchors including Macy's, JCPenney, and Forever 21, the mall offers a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues that cater to families and shoppers throughout Riverside and surrounding communities.
summary: A major enclosed regional shopping mall in Riverside's Tyler Mall area, anchored by department stores and featuring over 140 retailers serving the Inland Empire.
